scope: Design parity matrix: source-of-intent, not an import manifest or proof of working functionality
source_reference: original/main as reviewed 2026-11-08; MarburgumII reconciled through 2026-11-11 19:52 UTC (976f80c9), including ADR-040–045
rules: Preserve original Marburgum gameplay identity by default.
Rebuild runtime technology, networking and implementation rather than copying code.
Never treat legacy design or catalog existence as MarburgumII implementation.
Never import data/assets without provenance, rights and historical/geometric review.
Any intentional redesign requires an ADR and explicit parity-matrix update.
Explicit exclusions override original parity: no wanted stars, wanted levels, police pursuit/chases, or generated talent UI.
Every major playable feature requires personal in-game owner playtest and recorded approval.

Current default /Game/World/lent now spans nine original 512 m windows with survey-based LiDAR ground and OSM paved collision (ADR-040/045). Reverted ADR-026 concerned LiDAR-generated building-map replacement, not use of LiDAR terrain heights. TurboSquid 1639711 remains unpurchased candidate requiring separate license and owner-approved migration.

entries.name: Marburgum geography and district identity
entries.intent: A recognizably Maribor-based 1990s fictional city with the Drava, districts, places, buildings and route geography.
entries.migration: ADR-027 remains one /Game/World/lent default, now extended by ADR-040/045 to a 1,536 m square: nine original 512 m windows, 870 closed building shells (751 added), LiDAR 2014 heightfield, OSM collision paving, neighbouring Drava/bridges. 4,089,551 saved paving collision samples and selected editor-mode game smokes passed; streaming/World Partition, packaged performance, 1990s corrections and owner approval pending. ADR-026 generated LiDAR building-shell replacement reverted; paid TurboSquid model remains unpurchased candidate.

entries.name: 1990s culture and period correctness
entries.intent: 1990–1999 historically grounded vehicles, institutions, businesses, media, technology, signage and social change; distinguish evidence from fictionalization.
entries.migration: Retain source IDs, asserted dates, uncertainty, licensing and design approvals. New 2022 GIS geometry must not be presented as a faithful 1990s city without reviewed changes.

entries.name: Characters, NPCs and virtual population
entries.intent: Individual NPCs and broader simulated community with neighborhoods, schedules, social roles and contextual reactions.
entries.migration: Original Lent angler, three fight cast NPCs and new ADR-044 ambient street people using author-owned groups, looks and decision tables plus independent spawn/cull and car collision logic. Pavement walk graph, server pedestrian replication, reactions to fights, body and run-over, panic/dodge are editor-tested with one client; staged multi-client, density, schedules and owner review are pending.

entries.name: Skill progression
entries.intent: Keep skills as the major progression system. Original source registered Fishing, Photography, Housing, Trading and Reputation; fifteen were in the long-term design roster. Preserve original 0–1990 level identity for design review.
entries.migration: Agree and regression-test XP curve/levels before shipping; do not import auto-generated talents or imply all fifteen are implemented.

entries.name: Fishing
entries.intent: River fishing as an ordinary persistent skill and a representative stateful interaction loop.
entries.migration: New server-owned cast/wait/bite/hook result, catch/XP and idempotent inventory effects. Fish species/habitats and gameplay identities stay intact across base-map replacement; map riverbank anchors require geospatial validation.

entries.name: Missions, story and evidence
entries.intent: The City in the Ledger narrative, investigations, character choices, evidence and long-running authored urban missions rather than fantasy quests.
entries.migration: Original lent_first_catch mission starts, saves and grants a rod with authoritative idempotent receipt. Fishing and the rest of mission progression are not implemented.

entries.name: Reputation, relationships and organizations
entries.intent: A reversible public-facing Reputation measure with distinct local relationships, institutional contexts and social consequences.
entries.migration: Keep decisions and witness knowledge server-owned; avoid auto-duplicating bars for every group.

entries.name: Economy and trading
entries.intent: Money, inventory, vendors, local opportunities and bounded, understandable exchange with historical context.
entries.migration: Implement atomic integer-money/item transactions, receipts, validation and retry safety before player-to-player markets.

entries.name: Items, clues and inventory
entries.intent: Ordinary goods, equipment and evidence as durable state connected to missions, work and skills.
entries.migration: Separate definitions/instances; ensure unique ownership and double-spend prevention.

entries.name: Housing and property
entries.intent: Persistent housing access, interior use and social/economic consequences.
entries.migration: Server-owned property/permissions and address/interior identities; scale after the first district.

entries.name: Unarmed fighting and NPCs answering violence
entries.intent: Close-quarters fistfights with a jab, a committed swing and a held guard paid in stamina; NPCs that answer violence (a hostile fights whoever hits it, civilians step away); a fight ends at incapacitated, never death.
entries.migration: ADR-041 original jab/heavy/guard, stamina/cooldowns, server target and damage, Lent fighters, down/recovery, procedural animations and Kenney CC0 sounds; earlier packaged two-client smoke passed. ADR-043 corrects post-graph foot IK (tested in editor); new nine-window map needs fresh packaged run. No PvP, weapons, wanted/police, remote perception or broader consequences.

entries.name: Vehicles and transportation
entries.intent: Period-appropriate driving, roads, public transit, vehicle state, logistics and movement convenience.
entries.migration: ADR-039 first authored car and dedicated server driving with seats/door/camera; ADR-040 parks on paved carriageway, ADR-043 fixes generated foot IK clip and ADR-044 applies server car/pedestrian strike/dodge. Earlier packaged vehicle smoke passed, new composite/collision and street scenarios only editor-tested. Vehicle save/ownership/fuel/traffic/physical damage/audio still absent.

entries.name: City time, seasonal weather and environment
entries.intent: Shared local clock, dynamic weather, year-state and consequences for NPCs/mission opportunities.
entries.migration: Distinguish civil simulation time from real wall clock; synchronize replicated world state. ADR-061 ports the original's automatic Maribor climate weather (feat/dynamic-weather) to the server and replicates it; wetness drives car grip on newly classified Lent surfaces and footstep sounds. Weather visuals/audio, a world clock, day/night and gameplay consequences remain pending.

entries.name: Unified urban interaction verbs
entries.intent: Talk, inspect, take, use, work, fish, photograph, trade, drive and other city actions under coherent interaction rules.
entries.migration: Establish client request → server validation → authoritative result from first gameplay proof.

entries.name: Employment, opportunity scarcity and fairness
entries.intent: City jobs and limited opportunities, with safeguards for repeatedly unlucky players and story-critical access.
entries.migration: Preserve the thematic design without adopting untested scarcity percentages or soft-locking the main story.

entries.name: Player-facing UI and journal
entries.intent: Preserve original low-clutter HUD semantics, contextual prompts/location banner/objective/condition and notifications plus Character/Skills/Inventory/Journal, rebuilt immediately as a premium graphical, responsive UE 5.8.3 client interface for genuine public-facing gameplay captures. Module IDs, authority provenance, privacy/focus policy, status feedback, and later player layout profiles use the independent UI/HUD ontology.
entries.migration: UMG shell, chat, prompt/location/objective/condition/swim/car, first Character/Inventory/Journal; ADR-041 combat notification feed has real server event inputs. ADR-044 ambient people visible/reaction in world, not a shipped crowd UI; Skills/Settings, public login/creator, conflict-free F/R/G/E/chat/vehicle inputs and full responsive/owner acceptance pending.

entries.name: Dedicated authoritative MMORPG world
entries.intent: Separate client/shared/server code, persistent world/character state, reconnect, bounded AOI and eventual shared-shard scale.
entries.migration: New UE 5.8.3 source modules, Unreal-native replication baseline, native server/client proof at Stage 0. Do NOT silently preserve old protocol-v3 wire compatibility.

excluded_features.source: Original HUD and police response system
excluded_features.scope: No wanted stars, heat counter, wanted level, UI meter, thresholds or HUD feedback in MarburgumII.
No AI police pursuit/escalation system, chase gameplay loop, roadblocks or chase-specific interface migrated.
No generated talent trees and no Talent UI screen.
